summary: Built a persistent three-member etcd 3.7.1 cluster on node1–node3 with mutual TLS. Node4 is configured for administration and holds a verified current snapshot. The required key is present, and leader-loss recovery was successfully exercised.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified etcd binaries on all four nodes.
Created node-local member keys, a node4 CA/admin identity, persistent systemd services, and restricted firewall rules.
Stopped leader node2, proved surviving quorum reads/writes, restarted it, and verified data resynchronization.
Saved `/var/backups/etcd/etcd-recovery-current.db` with a verified SHA-256 sidecar.

evidence.requirement: Three-member persistent cluster with node4 administration
evidence.summary: All member services are active and enabled; final membership lists node1, node2, and node3 as three voting members with identical applied index 23. Node4 successfully administered all endpoints.

evidence.requirement: Mutual TLS for client and peer traffic
evidence.summary: Both client and peer listeners require verified client certificates; certificate-less requests to ports 2379 and 2380 were rejected with `tlsv13 alert certificate required`.
`/infraset/restore-proof=ready` was committed and remains linearly readable through every member.

Healthy baseline captured; leader node2 was stopped; node1/node3 elected a new leader and committed/read revision 3; node2 was restored, served the outage-period write, and converged with all members at applied index 20.
The root-only snapshot checksum verifies successfully and reports revision 3 with both stored keys.
